title: calea fruticosa
intro: Calea fruticosa, commonly known as "Dream Herb" or "Mexican Dream Herb," is a plant in the daisy family native to Mexico and parts of Central America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing anxiety, stress, and promoting relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal teas and supplements. The therapeutic actions of Calea fruticosa are attributed to its ability to modulate the central nervous system and promote a sense of calmness and well-being, likely due to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids. Research suggests that these bioactive compounds may be responsible for the plant's sedative and anxiolytic effects, although more studies are needed to confirm its full range of benefits.
